known_limits: Zero interviews, zero external usability sessions and zero real employment trials. Protocol and measurement tools are prepared.
No actual screen-reader or physical-phone study; automated accessibility and browser checks cover the stated screens.
Local HTTPS is verified. There is no public deployment, publication or submitted contest entry.
Operator, financing and external partnerships are not confirmed. Host disk encryption and off-host backup remain deployment responsibilities.
The public extraction corpus remains skewed toward missing fields; its reported success rate is not representative extraction accuracy.
Routing uses the pinned graph valid from 2026-10-02 to 2026-11-15. Timetable routing does not guarantee actual punctuality.
Solver feasibility and optimum apply only to the declared dates, start grid, resources, ordering and handoffs. Resource limits return explicit unresolved results.
Confirmed open accessibility defect: catalogue filtering does not announce the current result count or no-results state through a live status region.

The final AI UX audit is partial. Its high-priority old-date-analysis claim was not reproduced by two documented input methods; raw report and separate reproduction evidence are preserved, without claiming all paths are disproved.
Date-range feedback remains without explicit aria-invalid/aria-describedby, although the message is part of the field accessible name. No actual screen-reader test was performed.

independent_ux_audit.final_reason: Zbadano aplikację i główną ścieżkę przykładu. Nie sprawdzono wszystkich formularzy, trwałego zapisu, importu, eksportu ani rzeczywistego powiększenia 200%.

final_findings_disposition.evidence: Normal fill and trusted keyboard day-segment changes retained the invalid entered date, showed a range error, disabled analysis and sent no solve request before leaving the form. Positive controls sent and analysed the new 2026-10-05 to 2026-10-08 range. After leaving and returning, the entered invalid date remained but its local error cleared and the button was enabled; that invalid resubmission was not clicked. The discrepancy is unexplained and not every path was disproved.
Catalogue filtering changes visible results without announcing their count or absence in a live status region.

independent_ux_audit.additional_open_observation: The date-range error is included in the wrapping label and accessible name, but lacks explicit aria-invalid and aria-describedby. Actual screen-reader output remains untested.
